title: Red cells given to neonates under anaesthesia

statement.cohort: Every anaesthetic of a child under 28 days old at its start, leaving out test patients.
statement.outcome: The volume of red cells charted during the anaesthetic, in millilitres.
statement.result: One row with the number of anaesthetics and the total millilitres of red cells.

decisions.decision: A neonate is under 28 days old at the start of the anaesthetic, counted by calendar date.

question_sql:
WITH neonatal AS (SELECT a.anaesthetic_key FROM role_anaesthetic a JOIN role_patient p ON p.patient_key = a.patient_key WHERE p.is_test = 0 AND DATEDIFF(day, p.birth_date, a.start_time) < 28)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS anaesthetics, SUM(f.volume_ml) AS red_cells_ml FROM neonatal n JOIN role_fluid f ON f.anaesthetic_key = n.anaesthetic_key WHERE f.kind = 'red_cells'
